---
title: "easydta: single-test DTA meta-analysis (anti-CCP2)"
output: html_document
---

```{r packages}
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}
if (!requireNamespace("easydta", quietly = TRUE)) {
  remotes::install_github("vanioljantunes/easydta")
}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2, grid, gridExtra, easydta)
```

```{r load_data}
# Cochrane Handbook chapter 10 / Appendix 14 anti-CCP dataset
# (Nishimura et al. systematic review).  Each row is one study with a
# 2x2 table; `generation` carries the test type (CCP1 vs CCP2).
path <- system.file("extdata/anti_ccp.csv", package = "easydta")
d <- utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# For the single-test demo we restrict to the larger CCP2 subset.
d <- d[d$generation == "CCP2", ]
head(d)
```

```{r fit}
fit <- dta_fit_single(d, wide = TRUE,
                      tp = "TP", fp = "FP", fn = "FN", tn = "TN",
                      studlab = "studlab")
print(fit)
```

```{r save_forest}
png("forest_ccp2.png", width = 1400, height = 1000, res = 150)
dta_forest(fit)
dev.off()
```

```{r save_sroc}
png("sroc_ccp2.png", width = 1200, height = 1000, res = 150)
p <- dta_sroc(fit, test = "anti-CCP2",
              outcome = "rheumatoid arthritis",
              population = "adults")
print(p)
dev.off()
```
